notes.title: Biotech Samurai Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hi, and we are super glad to announce that we just made biggest game update - Biotech Samurai.
Many of you asked to fix and add some elements and we did that!
First of all, we fixed some bugs in main menu and in the game. Secondly, we added exit button to main menu. Lastly, we added beta support of controller in Biotech Samurai!!!

Enjoy your gameplay!
